scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run check:rust && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:claim:review-before-move: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features claim_review_before_move && playwright test --grep @claim:review-before-move
